questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Heritage connects inherited objects and practices with present choices.
options: Heritage connects inherited objects and practices with present choices.
A recording guarantees that a tradition remains in use.
Heritage decisions involve technical issues but no values.
Every community gives a place exactly the same meaning.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Heritage connects inherited objects and practices with present choices.

source.en: Responsible decisions therefore involve dialogue about continuity, change, access, and the stories that future generations will inherit.
